title: Sustainability in Products and Client Conversations
summary: How sustainability features are built into products and services, how client sustainability preferences are captured, and how to discuss ESG with clients accurately and fairly.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: How sustainability features are built into products and services, how client sustainability preferences are captured, and how to discuss ESG with clients accurately and fairly.
Learning Objectives: Explain how sustainability characteristics are reflected in product design and labels
Capture and respond to client sustainability preferences appropriately
Answer common client questions on ESG accurately and within their role
Syllabus: Sustainable funds, green bonds, sustainability-linked loans and insurance products
Product labels and categories: what they do and do not mean
Handling client questions: balance, evidence and knowing when to refer
Intended Audience: All staff in regulated firms, including new joiners and colleagues who are new to sustainability topics
Client-facing, product, marketing, investment, operations and risk staff whose work touches ESG products or claims
Line managers who need their teams to discuss sustainability accurately with clients
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: No prior knowledge of sustainability or ESG is required. The programme is suitable for new joiners and as annual refresher training.
Core Reading: NGFS (2019), A Call for Action: Climate Change as a Source of Financial Risk
IOSCO (2023), Supervisory Practices to Address Greenwashing
